baseline.pushedReference: origin/dev matches HEAD. The pushed local launcher hard-codes -Xms2g and 16m G1 regions without an explicit maximum; the untracked G184 release builder duplicates the same values. Preserve all unrelated dirty work.

businessDifference.conflictSummary: Existing release notes preserve a 2GiB initial heap and both launch paths duplicate that value; the long-lived desktop client remains heavily committed while idle and has no heap/direct-memory telemetry.
businessDifference.userDecision: Use the proposed desktop JVM policy: one shared option source with 512MiB initial heap, 6GiB maximum, 16MiB G1 regions and five-minute periodic G1; add lightweight startup, task lifecycle and periodic memory diagnostics.

implementationStatus: One shared option file feeds local launch and jpackage. A read-only ClientMemoryMetricsService logs application-ready, five-minute and committed task lifecycle snapshots. Window task behavior, capture, matching, input and Cloud semantics are unchanged. The registry gate now accepts already-established multi-segment domain ids.
